market_odds: The betting market's price on the horse
closer_advantage: How much the shape of the race suits horses that finish from behind
barrier_draw: The barrier (starting gate) the horse drew
weighted_form_score: A score for the last five runs, with the most recent runs counting most and winning margin taken into account
trainer_trial_pattern: How well this trainer's horses go after a barrier trial, compared with that trainer's own first-up record
field_size: How many horses are in the race
pace_pressure_score: How much early speed the field holds, from the mix of running styles in the race
field_size_context: Field size expressed as a fraction of a full field
td_upset_rate: How often this track and distance produces an upset result
leader_advantage: How much the shape of the race suits front-runners
days_since_run: Days since the horse's last start
td_pace_bias: Whether this track and distance favours on-pace or off-pace runners
z_800m: How fast the horse ran the 800m section of its last race, compared with the rest of that field
trial_recency: Days since the horse's most recent barrier trial
jockey_booking_change: Whether the jockey booked is an upgrade or a downgrade on last start
trip_cost_seconds: Time the horse is expected to lose from being drawn wide
speed_rating_trajectory: Whether the horse's speed ratings are rising or falling
sectional_rank_at_distance: How the horse's sectional times rank against others at this distance
improvement_score: How much the horse has improved from run to run
sectional_trajectory: Whether the horse's sectional times are getting quicker or slower
td_closing_speed_bias: Whether this track and distance rewards a strong finish
trial_quality_score: How strong the horses were that it trialled against
weight_change: Change in weight carried since last start
z_600m: How fast the horse ran the 600m section of its last race, compared with that field
trial_x_experience: How well it trialled, weighted up for a horse with few career starts
trial_count_60d: How many barrier trials it has had in the last 60 days
barrier_relevance_score: How much the barrier actually matters at this distance
market_efficiency_flag: Which class bracket the race sits in (the name is misleading, nothing about it comes from the market)
rsi: The pace environment the horse met in its last race
lambda_decay: How quickly the horse slows down late, which separates stayers from sprinters
svi: Whether the horse sustains its speed to the line or fades
z_400m: How fast the horse ran the 400m section of its last race, compared with that field
distance_direction_flag: Whether the horse is stepping up or dropping back in trip
second_up_win_rate: Its win rate at the second run back from a spell
z_200m: How fast the horse ran the final 200m of its last race, compared with that field
first_up_win_rate: Its win rate first-up from a spell
jockey_trainer_strike_rate: The win rate of this jockey and trainer working together
course_strike_rate: Its win rate at this course
consistency_score: How consistent its recent finishing positions have been
form_direction_slope: The trend line through its recent finishing positions
sectional_x_going: Its sectional speed considered alongside the state of the ground
is_improving: A flag for a horse on an upward trend
bounce_severity: How much of a drop-off to expect after an unusually big effort
is_winning_combo: A flag for a jockey and trainer pairing with a strong record together
is_in_form_cycle: A flag for being in the productive part of a preparation
has_sectional_data: Whether sectional timing data exists for this horse at all
runs_since_peak: How many runs since its best recent effort
distance_strike_rate: Its win rate at around this distance
fitness_x_distance: Its fitness considered alongside the race distance
is_bounce_candidate: A flag for a horse at risk of a drop-off after a peak run
campaign_run_number: Which run of the current preparation this is
is_first_up: A flag for first run back from a spell
campaign_run_x_fitness: Run number in the preparation considered alongside fitness
